snippet.title: The Cranberries - Zombie (Lyrics)
snippet.description:
The Cranberries - Zombie (Lyrics)

Lyrics:

[Verse 1]
Another head hangs lowly
Child is slowly taken
And the violence caused such silence
Who are we, mistaken?

[Pre-Chorus]
But you see, it's not me, it's not my family
In your head, in your head, they are fightin'
With their tanks and their bombs and their bombs and their guns
In your head, in your head, they are cryin'

[Chorus]
In your head, in your head
Zombie, zombie, zombie-ie-ie
What's in your head, in your head?
Zombie, zombie, zombie-ie-ie-ie, oh

[Post-Chorus]
Doo, doo, doo, doo
Doo, doo, doo, doo
Doo, doo, doo, doo
Doo, doo, doo, doo

[Verse 2]
Another mother's breakin'
Heart is takin' over
When the violence causes silence
We must be mistaken

snippet.title: Hands Over: Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Get your first look at Hands Over, a multiplayer horror party game where you'll be playing your favorite childhood games...except here, they can be fatal. Players sit at the table and face brutal versions of games like Crocodile Dentist, Pie Face, and memory challenges. Every turn is built around tension, bluffing, sabotage, and the fear that one small mistake could end the round. snippet.title: Christopher Nolan STUNNED As Woke Odyssey Trailer BOMBED Online!?
snippet.description:
►Christopher Nolan STUNNED As Woke Odyssey Trailer BOMBED Online!?

Christopher Nolan's Odyssey trailer just became the most disliked preview of his entire career, and the numbers behind that backlash are far more telling than most coverage has admitted. Sitting at roughly 315,000 likes against 83,000 dislikes on the main Universal upload, with even worse ratios on regional channels, this is a verifiable shift in audience response to a director who has spent twenty-five years building near-untouchable trust. In this video, we break down exactly why the backlash to The Odyssey is being driven by real, identifiable choices in the trailer itself, and why the audience pushing back deserves to be taken seriously rather than dismissed. We walk through the viral "daddy" line from Robert Pattinson, the modern American accents that pulled viewers out of the ancient Greek setting, the muted color palette that strips the Mediterranean of its actual character, and the Agamemnon armor debate that critics famously compared to "Batman with a hint of Warhammer 40K." You will also hear a full breakdown of Nolan's own defense of these choices from his May 2026 Time magazine interview, including his blackened bronze argument, his Travis Scott casting reasoning, and his Emily Wilson translation choice. We examine where his defense holds up and where it contradicts the source material he claims to honor. By the end, you will have a clear-eyed picture of why this $250 million production, the first commercial film shot entirely on IMAX 70mm, is heading toward its July 17th, 2026 release with a divided audience, and why the people uncomfortable with what they have seen are not gatekeepers, they are paying attention. snippet.title: Simon & Garfunkel - Bridge Over Troubled Water (Lyrics)
snippet.description:
simon & garfunkel - bridge over troubled water

thank you for spending a moment here with us. 
we hope the music brought you a little comfort.

feel free to subscribe if you felt the warmth of the music 🌟

· follow Simon & Garfunkel
spotify: https://open.spotify.com/artist/70cRZdQywnSFp9pnc2WTCE?si=dRUgTR5rT82g7Rn1Er4vAA
apple music: https://music.apple.com/us/artist/simon-garfunkel/461503

lyrics:
[verse 1]
when you're weary
feeling small
when tears are in your eyes
i will dry them all
i'm on your side
oh, when times get rough
and friends just can't be found

[chorus]
like a bridge over troubled water
i will lay me down
like a bridge over troubled water
i will lay me down

[verse 2]
when you're down and out
when you're on the street
when evening falls so hard
i will comfort you
i'll take your part
oh, when darkness comes
and pain is all around

[chorus]
like a bridge over troubled water
i will lay me down
like a bridge over troubled water
i will lay me down

[verse 3]
sail on, silver girl
sail on by
your time has come to shine
all your dreams are on their way
see how they shine
oh, if you need a friend
i'm sailing right behind

[chorus]
like a bridge over troubled water
i will ease your mind
like a bridge over troubled water
i will ease your mind

#simonandgarfunkel #bridgeovertroubledwater

What is Roblox? ROBLOX is an online virtual playground and workshop, where kids of all ages can safely interact, create, have fun, and learn. It’s unique in that practically everything on ROBLOX is designed and constructed by members of the community. ROBLOX is designed for 13 to 18 year olds, but it is open to people of all ages. Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation. There is no cost for this first plot of virtual land. By participating and by building cool stuff, ROBLOX members can earn specialty badges as well as ROBLOX dollars (“Robux”). In turn, they can shop the online catalog to purchase avatar clothing and accessories as well as premium building materials, interactive components, and working mechanisms.

snippet.title: NRG vs G2 - VCT Americas Stage 1 Playoffs - Lower Finals
snippet.description:
VCT Americas Stage 1 marks the next step in the race to Champions Shanghai, and the stakes could not be higher. Twelve teams, two groups, and only three spots on the line.

Group Alpha is fueled by one central clash. Brazil versus the Americas. LOUD, MIBR led by Aspas, and FURIA bring regional pride, while Leviatán and Cloud9 look to challenge them. G2 stands in the middle, ready to prove they still belong among the elite.Group Omega is shaped by pressure. NRG stand as the favorites, but KRÜ arrive ready to fight, and Envy reenters the spotlight with legendary names looking to prove they can still compete.

Only 3 teams will reach Masters London. Tune in to find out Americas representatives!

We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, and Verizon.

snippet.description:
This is Minecraft But we're Upgrading SUNMAN Into a GOD In Minecraft! When Steve's body gets transformed into SUNMAN Monsters like the FROST SUNMAN, SUPERNOVA SUNMAN he needs to UPGRADE himself by entering the mysterious portals! Steve needs to learn how to evolve himself to absurd levels so he can use the amazing overpowered upgrade abilities! Can Steve learn all the secrets and abilities of the evolution upgrades, get all the Sun Man upgrades, and upgrade into the ultimate Sunman? This is Upgrading SUNMAN Into a GOD in Minecraft
__

📸 Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/checkpoint.yt

MORE CHECKPOINT ADVENTURES:

‣ MINECRAFT DIMENSION: https://bit.ly/3mKfUOL


Minecraft is an open world game that has no specific goals for the player to accomplish, allowing players a large amount of freedom in choosing how to play the game however, there is an achievement system. The gameplay by default is first person, but players have the option to play in third person mode. The core gameplay revolves around breaking and placing blocks. The game world is essentially composed of rough 3D objects—mainly cubes—that are arranged in a fixed grid pattern and represent different materials, such as dirt, stone, various ores, water, and tree trunks. While players can move freely across the world, objects and items can only be placed at fixed locations relative to the grid. Players can gather these material blocks and place them elsewhere, thus allowing for various constructions.

snippet.title: Fallout 4, But I Bleed Caps?
snippet.description:
[In Today's video we'll be tackling Fallout 4 with a specific challenge in mind... everytime I take damage, I will lose caps out of my inventory. The amount of caps I drop is tied to my characters level + death count, and when it reaches 0... I'll stop being alive, resulting in a situation that can only get worse.

We'll venture across the commonwealth, tackling mutants and synths alike as we try to stockpile caps to avoid going bankrupt... But will SURVIVAL difficulty prove to be too much? Will I get softlocked before the run is done? Lets find out!] - original video text.

Thank you guys for watching! I loved this challenge and it sucked seeing it waste away so reuploading it was the only choice! Thanks again for the support, spent the last 2-3 weeks ill from an Elvis Presley impersonator concert... It's been rough but I'm back to full health! Each player starts by choosing an avatar and giving it an identity. They can then explore ROBLOX — interacting with others by chatting, playing games, or collaborating on creative projects. Each player is also given their own piece of undeveloped real estate along with a virtual toolbox with which to design and build anything — be it a navigable skyscraper, a working helicopter, a giant pinball machine, a multiplayer “Capture the Flag” game, or some other, yet-to-be-dreamed-up creation.
